detail.longDescription: Can GenAI be trained to mimic human markers of extended written assignments in higher education? "These findings suggest that current LLMs do not reliably reproduce human judgement in the marking of extended written work, with important implications for assessment practice and GenAI-assisted benchmarking of marks." Kay, W. P. et al. (2026) ‘Can GenAI be trained to mimic human markers of extended written assignments in higher education?’, Assessment & Evaluation in Higher Education, pp. 1–21. doi: https:// doi.org/10.1080/02602938.2026. 2710688 . # OpenAccess # OA # Research # Article # AI # Artificialintelligence # Technology # Tech # LLM # Education # Learning # Academia
